question:
An electronics firm forecasts annual profit as $P(x)=500+40x-0.4x^2$, $x$ (in 1000s units).

(a) Find the production $x$ for maximum profit.

(b) Calculate maximum profit.

(c) Confirm maxima with calculus.

options.A:
(a) Maximum profit occurs at $x=40$.
(b) Maximum profit $=1400$ ($\times 1000$), i.e., Rs. 1,400,000.
(c) $P''=-0.8<0$, so it is a maximum.
options.B:
(a) Maximum profit occurs at $x=60$.
(b) Maximum profit $=1460$ ($\times 1000$), i.e., Rs. 1,460,000.
(c) $P''=0.8>0$, so it is a maximum.
options.C:
(a) Maximum profit occurs at $x=50$.
(b) Maximum profit $=2500$ ($\times 1000$), i.e., Rs. 2,500,000.
(c) $P''=-0.8<0$, so it is a maximum.
options.D:
(a) Maximum profit occurs at $x=50$.
(b) Maximum profit $=1500$ ($\times 1000$), i.e., Rs. 1,500,000.
(c) $P''=-0.8<0$, so it is a maximum.
